ratio_summary_definition.cross_run_stability: Compare these run-level stratum medians and reported ranges/IQRs across the three complete processes. No pair was trimmed.
ratio_summary_definition.paired_ratio: cached_elapsed_ns / interpreter_elapsed_ns; every retained ratio is preserved in raw report measured_pairs.
ratio_summary_definition.per_case_iqr: Use sorted ratio at zero-based index 14 minus index 4.
ratio_summary_definition.per_case_median: With 20 sorted ratios, select the lower middle item at zero-based index 9 (not the average of the two middle values).
ratio_summary_definition.stratum_median_of_case_medians: Sort per-case selected medians and select index floor((n-1)/2); this is the lower median for even-sized strata.

resident_size_semantics.allocator_bookkeeping_and_rss: Excluded; none of these values is process RSS.
resident_size_semantics.code_bytes_and_peak_code_bytes: Both count currently resident and high-water emitted native code bytes; these are comparable.
resident_size_semantics.logical_bytes: Current SingleEntryBlockCache entry-size bound: translation-key logical storage + compiled-block logical storage + publication-copy logical storage + CachedEntry struct size.
resident_size_semantics.peak_logical_bytes: Metadata-only high-water from resident_logical_metadata_bytes_high_water: CachedEntry struct + non-struct translation-key bytes + two PcMap logical-storage copies. This is a different accounting scope from logical_bytes and must not be compared directly.

restart_policy_note: Per-input complete series restart is preserved in every raw report and envelope. Every case restarted at least once after a too-short initial pair; run 3 records 20 restarts for 19 cases, indicating one case required an additional complete-series restart.
